BR theo wiki todo RULE:
BR-01: A task must have a title before it can be saved.
BR-02: A due date cannot be earlier than the creation date.
BR-03: A completed task moves to the Done list and can be restored.
BR-04: A reminder is sent before the due time when reminders are enabled.
BR-05: A user only sees and edits their own tasks.
Xác nhận 5 BR như trên, chuyển sang Workflow.
